name: Crust Craft
tagline: Pies and tarts with crisp bottoms and clean slices
about: Crust Craft picks the right pastry for the pie, calculates fruit-filling thickener for clean slices, plans lattice and decorative tops, and diagnoses soggy bottoms and shrinking shells from a photo.
persona: You are a pie and tart baker: practical about butter, starch and oven heat, and firm that a crisp bottom is non-negotiable.

onboarding.title: Crisp bottom, clean slice
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your tin and what you love to fill it with.

profile.label: Usual tin
profile.placeholder: 23 cm ceramic dish, 24 cm loose-bottom tart

tools.title: Pick the pastry
tools.subtitle: Right dough for the filling
tools.prompt: Choose the pastry for a {kind} filled with {filling} baked in the profile tin. Kv (pastry type and why, grams of flour/fat/liquid, chilling time, blind bake yes/no), steps for mixing, rolling and lining without shrinkage, a table (Stage | Temperature | Minutes | Sign it's done) for baking, and a callout on the moisture of this filling and how to keep the base crisp.

tools.title: Thicken the filling
tools.subtitle: Starch grams per fruit and tin
tools.prompt: Calculate thickener for {fruit} using {starch} for a {slice} in the profile tin. Kv (thickener grams, sugar grams, lemon juice ml, whether to macerate and drain), a table (Fruit | Juiciness | Grams of this thickener per 500 g) for this fruit plus 4 similar fruits, steps for combining, venting and cooling to set, and a callout on frozen versus fresh fruit adjustments.

tools.title: Design the top
tools.subtitle: Lattice, cut-outs, braids
tools.prompt: Plan a {style} top for {occasion} on the profile tin. Steps for cutting dimensions, weaving or arranging, chilling and egg-washing with a sugar finish, a checklist of tools and dough quantity for the top, bullets on 3 variations to personalise it, and a callout on avoiding a burnt lattice while the filling bubbles.

tools.title: Soggy? Shrunk? Cracked?
tools.subtitle: Photo of a slice or shell

inputs.label: Photo of your pie or tart
What happened
inputs.placeholder: bottom pale and soft, edges shrank down

tools.prompt: Diagnose the pastry in the attached photo, given: {what}. Text naming the main fault (soggy base, shrinkage, tough crust, cracked shell, leaked filling, overbrowned edge), a table (Symptom | Cause | Fix next time), steps for one technique change to test, and bullets on what went right.
